pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability delivery and verification readiness projection
pressure_hypothesis.title: Budgeted ECI hides provider readiness context for an excluded verification obligation
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a bounded, provenance-linked verification executor and provider readiness relationship in the ECI evidence-priority response.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability intelligence projection and evidence-priority compaction

request.operation: expose exact executor availability, provider checkout and toolchain state, and bounded same-provider capability availability in compact ECI output

outcome.implementation_scope: bounded provider execution readiness context for exact verification executor relationships, retained through ECI evidence-priority compaction
outcome.implementation_change: The projection relates integrity-verified verification outcomes to exact provider bindings and preserves substrate availability, provider checkout cleanliness and identity, declared toolchain checkout observations, bounded same-provider capability availability, and binding scan completeness. A compact ECI result retains up to two obligations with exact Store source references and explicit response-budget omission counts.
outcome.verified_change: The live ECI query surfaces the excluded mncs-test.native-application-build-vm obligation with its exact verification evidence and owner-result references. It shows the executor entrypoint as substrate-available, the selected mncs-test checkout as dirty, and the same-provider canonical-vm-tests capability as unavailable because its declared compiler toolchain cannot resolve in the selected closure. Readiness, causal attribution, agent receipt, ambient fulfillment, and agent burden remain unestablished or unmeasured.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: projection-behavior-verified-for-selected-session; cross-session service effectiveness and burden reduction not-assessed
not_measured: Whether agents can execute the obligation after the selected checkout and toolchain closure become ready.
Whether the exact context reduces investigation steps for another agent or session.
Whether an eligible service opportunity was missed or agent intervention burden decreased.
Whether the cited same-provider unavailable capability is a causal dependency of the executor.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
